assumptions: 실제 레거시 코드를 분석하거나 AI 코드를 실행한 결과가 아닙니다.
html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>다운로드 센터 | myPOSCO Demo — 카탈로그 미리보기 목업</title>
<!--
    [레거시 확인용 목업] 다운로드 센터 > 제품 카탈로그 미리보기 기능 추가
    - 요구사항: requirements_catalog-preview.md (v1.0)
    - 기준 화면: myposco-demo-front/pages/download-center/download-center.html
    - 스타일: myposco-demo-front/css/common.css, layout.css, downloadCenter.css 를 그대로 인라인 (아래 LEGACY CSS)
    - 데이터: myposco-demo-back/db/init/02_data.sql, 03_download_material_file.sql 의 공개(publish_yn='Y') 카탈로그 11건
    - 신규 스타일은 "/* ===== [미리보기 추가] ===== */" 블록에만 작성
    - 단일 파일로 동작 (Backend 미연동, 미리보기 페이지는 가상 렌더링)
-->
<style>
/* ===================== LEGACY CSS (원본 그대로) ===================== */
/* =============================================================
   common.css — 디자인 토큰(색상·폰트·여백)과 공통 컴포넌트(버튼·입력·탭·뱃지·표·모달)
   참고: docs/references 의 My POSCO 화면 캡처 (색상·여백·버튼 스타일)
   ============================================================= */
:root {
    --color-primary: #3b6fe0;        /* 활성 탭, 카테고리 버튼, Q. */
    --color-primary-light: #f1f5fd;  /* FAQ 답변 배경, hover */
    --color-navy: #3a4774;           /* 조회 버튼, 강조 제목 */
    --color-text: #222222;
    --color-text-sub: #666666;
    --color-text-muted: #999999;
    --color-border: #dddddd;
    --color-border-strong: #3a4774;
    --color-bg-page: #f5f7fa;        /* 페이지 배경(연회색) */
    --color-bg-card: #ffffff;
    --color-bg-item: #f6f7f9;        /* 다운로드 카드 배경 */
    --color-danger: #e0453b;
    --color-success: #2f9e6a;
    --color-warning: #e39a26;

    --font-family: "Pretendard", "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", "맑은 고딕", sans-serif;
    --content-width: 1280px;
    --radius-card: 40px;
    --radius-item: 16px;
    --radius-button: 4px;
}

*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }

html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    font-family: var(--font-family);
    font-size: 16px;
    color: var(--color-text);
    background: var(--color-bg-page);
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
button { font-family: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
ul { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
h1, h2, h3, h4, p { margin: 0; }

.is-hidden { display: none !important; }

/* ---------- 버튼 ---------- */
.btn {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 6px;
    height: 48px;
    padding: 0 28px;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
    border-radius: var(--radius-button);
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 700;
    background: #fff;
    white-space: nowrap;
}
.btn:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }
.btn-primary { background: var(--color-primary); color: #fff; }
.btn-navy { background: var(--color-navy); color: #fff; min-width: 106px; }
.btn-outline { border-color: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-primary); }
.btn-gray { border-color: var(--color-border); color: var(--color-text-sub); }
.btn-small { height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 14px; }
.btn-round { border-radius: 999px; border-color: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-primary); }

/* 카테고리 칩 (FAQ 카테고리, 다운로드 센터 제품군 필터) */
.chip-group { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px; }
.chip {
    height: 52px;
    padding: 0 36px;
    border: 1px solid var(--color-primary);
    border-radius: var(--radius-button);
    background: #fff;
    color: var(--color-primary);
    font-size: 17px;
    font-weight: 700;
}
.chip.is-active { background: var(--color-primary); color: #fff; }

/* ---------- 입력 ---------- */
.form-input, .form-select, .form-textarea {
    height: 50px;
    padding: 0 14px;
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: 2px;
    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: var(--color-text);
    background: #fff;
}
.form-input::placeholder, .form-textarea::placeholder { color: var(--color-text-muted); }
.form-input:focus, .form-select:focus, .form-textarea:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-primary); }
.form-select { padding-right: 36px; }
.form-textarea { height: auto; min-height: 240px; padding: 14px; resize: vertical; line-height: 1.6; }

/* 검색바 (FAQ 캡처: [제목▼] [검색어] [조회]) */
.search-bar {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    gap: 16px;
    padding: 52px 0 22px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border);
}
.search-bar .form-select { width: 266px; }
.search-bar .form-input { width: 532px; }

/* ---------- 탭 (다운로드 센터 자료유형) ---------- */
.tab-list { display: flex; border-bottom: 1px solid #c8ccd4; }
.tab-item {
    flex: 1;
    height: 96px;
    border: 0;
    border-bottom: 4px solid transparent;
    background: transparent;
    font-size: 30px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #888;
    margin-bottom: -1px;
}
.tab-item.is-active { color: var(--color-primary); border-bottom-color: var(--color-primary); }

/* ---------- 뱃지 ---------- */
.badge {
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 4px 10px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 700;
    border: 1px solid currentColor;
}
.badge-received { color: var(--color-warning); }
.badge-in-progress { color: var(--color-primary); }
.badge-answered { color: var(--color-success); }
.badge-gray { color: var(--color-text-muted); }

/* ---------- 표 ---------- */
.data-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; border-top: 2px solid var(--color-border-strong); }
.data-table th, .data-table td { padding: 18px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border); text-align: center; font-size: 16px; }
.data-table th { font-weight: 700; background: #fafbfc; }
.data-table td.text-left { text-align: left; }
.data-table .empty-row td { padding: 60px 0; color: var(--color-text-muted); }

/* ---------- 페이지네이션 ---------- */
.pagination { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; margin-top: 36px; }
.pagination button {
    min-width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: #fff;
    font-size: 14px;
}
.pagination button.is-active { background: var(--color-navy); border-color: var(--color-navy); color: #fff; }

/* ---------- 모달 ---------- */
.modal-backdrop {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 200;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
}
.modal {
    width: 720px;
    max-height: 86vh;
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding: 40px 44px;
    border-radius: 24px;
    background: #fff;
}
.modal-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; margin-bottom: 24px; }
.modal-close { border: 0; background: transparent; font-size: 28px; line-height: 1; color: var(--color-text-sub); }

/* ---------- 상태 메시지 ---------- */
.empty-message { padding: 80px 0; text-align: center; color: var(--color-text-muted); font-size: 17px; }

/* =============================================================
   layout.css — 사이트 헤더(GNB), 고객지원 메가메뉴, 페이지 타이틀/브레드크럼, 본문 카드
   마크업은 js/common/layout.js 가 렌더링한다.
   참고: docs/references/menubar.png, downloadCenter.png, faq.png
   ============================================================= */

/* ---------- 헤더 ---------- */
.site-header {
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 100;
    background: #fff;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
}
.site-header-inner {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    height: 80px;
    padding: 0 80px;
}
.site-logo { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 2px; font-weight: 800; }
.site-logo-my { font-family: "Brush Script MT", cursive; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 400; color: #f0a830; }
.site-logo-name { font-size: 24px; letter-spacing: 0.5px; color: #2c3e7a; }
.site-logo-dx { margin-left: 10px; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.5px; color: #e0a43a; }

.gnb { position: absolute; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); display: flex; gap: 130px; }
.gnb-item {
    border: 0;
    background: transparent;
    padding: 28px 0;
    font-size: 19px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--color-text);
}
.gnb-item.is-active, .gnb-item:hover { color: var(--color-navy); }
.gnb-item.is-disabled { color: #bbb; cursor: default; }

.header-util { margin-left: auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; font-size: 16px; }
.header-search { width: 26px; height: 26px; border: 2px solid #555; border-radius: 50%; position: relative; opacity: 0.7; }
.header-search::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    right: -6px;
    bottom: -5px;
    width: 9px;
    height: 2px;
    background: #555;
    transform: rotate(45deg);
}
.header-user { font-weight: 700; color: var(--color-navy); }
.header-user-company { font-weight: 400; color: var(--color-text-sub); font-size: 14px; }
.header-lang { padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid #999; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #666; }
.header-admin-link { font-size: 13px; color: var(--color-text-muted); text-decoration: underline; }

/* ---------- 메가메뉴 ---------- */
.mega-menu {
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    top: 80px;
    z-index: 95;               /* .mega-menu-dim(90) 위에 표시 */
    background: #fff;
    border-top: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
    box-shadow: 0 12px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
}
.mega-menu-inner {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
    gap: 56px 80px;
    max-width: 1680px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 56px 160px 64px;
}
.mega-menu-group-title {
    padding-bottom: 20px;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #333;
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 700;
}
.mega-menu-link { display: block; padding: 8px 0; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-text); }
.mega-menu-link:hover { color: var(--color-primary); }
.mega-menu-link.is-disabled { color: #bbb; cursor: default; }
.mega-menu-link.is-disabled::after { content: " (준비중)"; font-size: 12px; }
.mega-menu-dim { position: fixed; left: 0; right: 0; top: 80px; bottom: 0; z-index: 90; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); }

/* ---------- 관리자 모드 띠 ---------- */
.admin-band { padding: 8px 80px; background: var(--color-navy); color: #fff; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; }

/* ---------- 페이지 타이틀 ---------- */
.page-title-area {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: flex-start;
    max-width: calc(var(--content-width) + 160px);
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 40px 0 64px;
}
.page-title-group { font-size: 22px; color: #777; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.page-title { font-size: 52px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -1px; }
.page-description { margin-top: 18px; font-size: 19px; color: var(--color-text); }
.breadcrumb { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding-top: 30px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--color-navy); }
.breadcrumb-separator { color: #bbb; font-weight: 400; }

/* ---------- 본문 ---------- */
.page-content { max-width: calc(var(--content-width) + 160px); margin: 0 auto; padding-bottom: 120px; }
.content-card {
    padding: 40px 80px 80px;
    border-radius: var(--radius-card);
    background: var(--color-bg-card);
}

.site-footer { padding: 32px 80px; border-top: 1px solid #e5e7eb; background: #fff; font-size: 13px; color: var(--color-text-muted); }

/* =============================================================
   downloadCenter.css — 다운로드 센터 화면 (참고: docs/references/downloadCenter.png)
   ============================================================= */

.download-tab-list { margin-bottom: 44px; }
.download-content-card { padding-top: 56px; }

.material-group { margin-top: 56px; }
.material-group-title { margin-bottom: 20px; font-size: 32px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--color-navy); }
.material-group-count { color: var(--color-primary); }

.material-card-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 20px; }

.material-card {
    display: flex;
    gap: 20px;
    padding: 14px 20px;
    border-radius: var(--radius-item);
    background: var(--color-bg-item);
}

/* ---------- 플레이스홀더 표지 (실제 카탈로그 이미지 대신 CSS 로 표현) ---------- */
.material-cover {
    --cover-color: #e9a3a3;
    position: relative;
    flex: 0 0 134px;
    height: 190px;
    padding: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 4px;
    background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse 90px 60px at 30% 32%, var(--cover-color), transparent 70%),
        #fff;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
    text-align: left;
}
.material-cover-brand { position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 8px; font-size: 8px; font-weight: 700; color: #2c3e7a; }
.material-cover-circle {
    position: absolute;
    right: -18px;
    bottom: 22px;
    width: 78px;
    height: 78px;
    border: 8px solid #eee;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #8a96a8, #3d4656);
}
.material-cover-title {
    position: absolute;
    left: 6px;
    bottom: 10px;
    max-width: 70px;
    padding-left: 5px;
    border-left: 2px solid var(--cover-color);
    font-size: 8px;
    font-weight: 700;
    line-height: 1.3;
    color: #a33;
}
.cover-HOT_ROLLED  { --cover-color: #d9a0a8; }
.cover-COLD_ROLLED { --cover-color: #f2c76e; }
.cover-PLATE       { --cover-color: #9fb7e0; }
.cover-WIRE_ROD    { --cover-color: #b9a3d9; }
.cover-STAINLESS   { --cover-color: #93d3c8; }
.cover-ELECTRICAL  { --cover-color: #a9d68f; }
.cover-COMMON      { --cover-color: #c4c9d2; }

/* ---------- 카드 본문 ---------- */
.material-card-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 22px; min-width: 0; }
.material-card-title {
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    background: transparent;
    text-align: left;
    font-size: 22px;
    font-weight: 800;
    color: var(--color-navy);
    word-break: keep-all;
}
.material-card-title:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

.material-download-links { display: flex; gap: 22px; }
.material-download-link {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #888;
}
.material-download-link:hover { color: var(--color-primary); }
.material-download-icon {
    position: relative;
    width: 18px;
    height: 18px;
    border: 2px solid currentColor;
    border-top: 0;
}
.material-download-icon::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    left: 50%;
    top: -6px;
    width: 2px;
    height: 13px;
    background: currentColor;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
}
.material-download-icon::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    left: 50%;
    top: 1px;
    width: 7px;
    height: 7px;
    border-right: 2px solid currentColor;
    border-bottom: 2px solid currentColor;
    transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(45deg);
}
.material-no-file { font-size: 14px; color: var(--color-text-muted); }

.download-history-link-area { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; margin-top: 28px; }

/* ---------- 상세 모달 ---------- */
.material-detail-category { margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--color-primary); }
.material-detail-title { font-size: 30px; font-weight: 800; }
.material-detail-info {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 90px 1fr;
    gap: 12px 16px;
    margin: 0 0 28px;
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 1.6;
}
.material-detail-info dt { font-weight: 700; color: var(--color-text-sub); }
.material-detail-info dd { margin: 0; }
.material-detail-files td, .material-detail-files th { padding: 12px 8px; font-size: 15px; }


/* ===================== [미리보기 추가] ===================== */

/* --- 표지: 미리보기 가능 표시 (FR-01) --- */
.material-cover { cursor: pointer; }
.material-cover-preview-badge {
    position: absolute;
    top: 6px;
    left: 6px;
    z-index: 2;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 26px;
    height: 26px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #fff;
    color: var(--color-primary);
    box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
}
.material-cover-preview-hover {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 3;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 6px;
    background: rgba(58, 71, 116, 0.72);
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 700;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.15s;
}
.material-cover:hover .material-cover-preview-hover,
.material-cover:focus-visible .material-cover-preview-hover { opacity: 1; }
.preview-eye-icon { display: block; width: 16px; height: 16px; }
.material-cover-preview-hover .preview-eye-icon { width: 28px; height: 28px; }

/* --- 카드: 미리보기 버튼 (FR-02) — 제목 아래 별도 행, 다운로드 링크는 기존 그대로 --- */
.material-card-body.has-preview { gap: 14px; }
.material-preview-link {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    align-self: flex-start;
    gap: 6px;
    height: 34px;
    padding: 0 14px;
    border: 1px solid var(--color-primary);
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: #fff;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--color-primary);
    white-space: nowrap;
}
.material-preview-link:hover { background: var(--color-primary); color: #fff; }

/* --- 미리보기 모달 (FR-03 ~ FR-08) — 공통 .modal 확장 --- */
.modal.material-preview-modal {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    width: 1120px;
    max-width: calc(100vw - 48px);
    height: 88vh;
    max-height: 880px;
    padding: 32px 36px 24px;
    overflow: hidden;
}
.material-preview-modal .modal-header { align-items: center; margin-bottom: 20px; }
.material-preview-header-right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; }
.material-preview-lang { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
.material-preview-lang .chip { height: 36px; padding: 0 18px; font-size: 14px; }
.material-preview-lang .chip:disabled { border-color: var(--color-border); color: #bbb; cursor: not-allowed; }

.material-preview-body { position: relative; display: flex; flex: 1; gap: 16px; min-height: 0; }
.material-preview-thumbs {
    flex: 0 0 140px;
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding: 14px 16px;
    border-radius: var(--radius-item);
    background: var(--color-bg-item);
}
.material-preview-thumb {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    background: transparent;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--color-text-sub);
}
.material-preview-thumb .preview-page {
    width: 100%;
    font-size: 3.4px;
    border: 2px solid transparent;
    pointer-events: none;
}
.material-preview-thumb span { display: block; margin-top: 4px; }
.material-preview-thumb.is-active .preview-page { border-color: var(--color-primary); }
.material-preview-thumb.is-active span { color: var(--color-primary); font-weight: 700; }

.material-preview-viewer {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    justify-content: center;
    overflow: auto;
    padding: 28px;
    border-radius: var(--radius-item);
    background: #e9ecf1;
}
.material-preview-viewer .preview-page {
    flex: none;
    width: calc(440px * var(--zoom, 1));
    font-size: calc(10px * var(--zoom, 1));
    box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
}
.material-preview-arrow {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;

const downloadCenterState = { productGroup: "", searchType: "TITLE", keyword: "" };
const materialPreviewState = { material: null, languageCode: "KOR", page: 1, zoom: 1 };

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initDownloadCenterPage);

function initDownloadCenterPage() {
    bindEvents();
    renderProductGroupChips();
    loadMaterialList();
}

function bindEvents() {
    document.getElementById("materialTypeTabs").addEventListener("click", handleMaterialTypeTabClick);
    document.getElementById("productGroupChips").addEventListener("click", handleProductGroupChipClick);
    document.getElementById("materialSearchButton").addEventListener("click", handleMaterialSearchClick);
    document.getElementById("searchKeywordInput").addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { if (e.key === "Enter") handleMaterialSearchClick(); });

function handleMaterialTypeTabClick(event) {
    const tab = event.target.closest("[data-material-type]");
    if (tab && tab.dataset.materialType !== "CATALOG") {
        alert("이 목업은 제품 카탈로그 탭의 미리보기 기능 확인용입니다.");
    }
}

function handleProductGroupChipClick(event) {
    const chip = event.target.closest("[data-product-group]");
    if (!chip) return;
    downloadCenterState.productGroup = chip.dataset.productGroup;
    renderProductGroupChips();
    loadMaterialList();
}

function handleMaterialSearchClick() {
    downloadCenterState.searchType = document.getElementById("searchTypeSelect").value;
    downloadCenterState.keyword = document.getElementById("searchKeywordInput").value.trim();
    loadMaterialList();
}

/** 표지·미리보기 버튼 → 미리보기 모달, 제목 → 상세 모달(기존) */
function handleMaterialCardClick(event) {
    const previewTrigger = event.target.closest("[data-preview-material-id]");
    if (previewTrigger) {
        openMaterialPreviewModal(Number(previewTrigger.dataset.previewMaterialId));
        return;
    }
    const detailTrigger = event.target.closest("[data-detail-material-id]");
    if (detailTrigger) openMaterialDetailModal(Number(detailTrigger.dataset.detailMaterialId));
    const downloadLink = event.target.closest(".material-download-link");
    if (downloadLink) {
        event.preventDefault();
        alert(`[목업] ${downloadLink.title}\n→ GET /api/download-center/files/${downloadLink.dataset.fileId}/download`);
    }
}

function loadMaterialList() {
    const { productGroup, searchType, keyword } = downloadCenterState;
    const materials = MATERIALS.filter((m) =>
        (!productGroup || m.productGroup === productGroup) &&
        (!keyword || (searchType === "TITLE" ? m.title + m.titleEn : m.summary + m.description).toLowerCase().includes(keyword.toLowerCase())));
    renderMaterialGroups(materials);
}

function renderProductGroupChips() {
    const chips = [{ code: "", codeName: "전체" }, ...PRODUCT_GROUPS];
    document.getElementById("productGroupChips").innerHTML = chips.map((group) => `
        <button type="button" class="chip ${group.code === downloadCenterState.productGroup ? "is-active" : ""}"
                data-product-group="${group.code}">${group.codeName}</button>`).join("");
}

function renderMaterialGroups(materials) {
    const resultArea = document.getElementById("materialResultArea");
    if (materials.length === 0) {
        resultArea.innerHTML = `<p class="empty-message">조회된 자료가 없습니다.</p>`;
        return;
    }
    resultArea.innerHTML = PRODUCT_GROUPS.map((group) => {
        const items = materials.filter((m) => m.productGroup === group.code);
        if (items.length === 0) return "";
        return `
        <section class="material-group">
            <h2 class="material-group-title">${group.codeName}<span class="material-group-count">(${items.length})</span></h2>
            <div class="material-card-grid">${items.map(renderMaterialCard).join("")}</div>
        </section>`;
    }).join("");
}

function renderMaterialCard(material) {
    const downloadLinks = material.files.map((file) => `
        <a class="material-download-link" href="#" data-file-id="${file.fileId}" title="${material.title} ${file.languageCode} 다운로드">
            <span class="material-download-icon" aria-hidden="true"></span>${file.languageCode}
        </a>`).join("");

    return `
        <article class="material-card">
            ${renderMaterialCover(material)}
            <div class="material-card-body has-preview">
                <button type="button" class="material-card-title" data-detail-material-id="${material.materialId}">${material.title}</button>
                <button type="button" class="material-preview-link" data-preview-material-id="${material.materialId}" title="${material.title} 미리보기">${EYE_ICON}미리보기</button>
                <div class="material-download-links">${downloadLinks}</div>
            </div>
        </article>`;
}

/** 레거시 플레이스홀더 표지 + [미리보기 추가] 눈 배지·호버 오버레이 */
function renderMaterialCover(material) {
    return `
        <button type="button" class="material-cover cover-${material.productGroup}"
                data-preview-material-id="${material.materialId}" aria-label="${material.title} 미리보기">
            <span class="material-cover-preview-badge">${EYE_ICON}</span>
            <span class="material-cover-brand">myPOSCO DX</span>
            <span class="material-cover-circle"></span>
            <span class="material-cover-title">${material.titleEn || material.title}</span>
            <span class="material-cover-preview-hover">${EYE_ICON}미리보기</span>
        </button>`;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------
// 상세 모달 (레거시 그대로)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------

function openMaterialDetailModal(materialId) {
    const detail = MATERIALS.find((m) => m.materialId === materialId);
    const groupName = PRODUCT_GROUPS.find((g) => g.code === detail.productGroup).codeName;
    document.getElementById("materialDetailCategory").textContent = `제품 카탈로그 · ${groupName}`;
    document.getElementById("materialDetailTitle").textContent = detail.title;
    const fileRows = detail.files.map((file) => `
        <tr>
            <td>${file.languageCode === "KOR" ? "국문" : "영문"}</td>
            <td class="text-left">${file.originalFileName}</td>
            <td>${file.fileSize} B</td>
            <td><a class="btn btn-outline btn-small" href="#">다운로드</a></td>
        </tr>`).join("");
    document.getElementById("materialDetailBody").innerHTML = `
        <dl class="material-detail-info">
            <dt>영문명</dt><dd>${detail.titleEn}</dd>
            <dt>요약</dt><dd>${detail.summary}</dd>
            <dt>설명</dt><dd>${detail.description}</dd>
            <dt>등록일</dt><dd>${detail.createdAt.replace(/-/g, ".")}</dd>
        </dl>
        <table class="data-table material-detail-files">
            <thead><tr><th>언어</th><th>파일명</th><th>크기</th><th>다운로드</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>${fileRows}</tbody>
        </table>`;
    document.getElementById("materialDetailModal").classList.remove("is-hidden");
}

function closeMaterialDetailModal() {
    document.getElementById("materialDetailModal").classList.add("is-hidden");
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------
// [미리보기 추가] 미리보기 모달
// ---------------------------------------------------------------

function openMaterialPreviewModal(materialId) {
    const material = MATERIALS.find((m) => m.materialId === materialId);
    const languages = material.files.map((f) => f.languageCode);
    Object.assign(materialPreviewState, {
        material,
        languageCode: languages.includes("KOR") ? "KOR" : languages[0],
        page: 1,
        zoom: 1,
    });
    const groupName = PRODUCT_GROUPS.find((g) => g.code === material.productGroup).codeName;
    document.getElementById("materialPreviewCategory").textContent = `제품 카탈로그 · ${groupName}`;
    document.getElementById("materialPreviewTitle").textContent = `${material.title} 카탈로그`;
    renderPreviewAll();
    document.getElementById("materialPreviewModal").classList.remove("is-hidden");
    document.body.classList.add("is-modal-open");
}

function closeMaterialPreviewModal() {
    document.getElementById("materialPreviewModal").classList.add("is-hidden");
    document.body.classList.remove("is-modal-open");
}

function isPreviewOpen() {
    return !document.getElementById("materialPreviewModal").classList.contains("is-hidden");
}

/** 제공 언어만 활성화 (예: API강은 ENG 전용, 아연도금강판은 KOR 전용) */
function renderPreviewLanguageButtons() {
    const available = materialPreviewState.material.files.map((f) => f.languageCode);
    document.getElementById("materialPreviewLangGroup").innerHTML = ["KOR", "ENG"].map((code) => `
        <button type="button" class="chip ${code === materialPreviewState.languageCode ? "is-active" : ""}"
                data-language-code="${code}" ${available.includes(code) ? "" : "disabled title=\"제공되지 않는 언어입니다\""}>${code}</button>`).join("");
}

function renderPreviewAll() {
    const { material, languageCode } = materialPreviewState;
    renderPreviewLanguageButtons();
    document.getElementById("materialPreviewPageTotal").textContent = material.pageCount;
    document.getElementById("materialPreviewDownload").textContent = `${languageCode} 다운로드`;
    document.getElementById("materialPreviewThumbs").innerHTML = Array.from({ length: material.pageCount }, (_, i) => `
        <button type="button" class="material-preview-thumb" data-preview-page="${i + 1}">
            ${buildPreviewPageHtml(material, i + 1, languageCode)}<span>${i + 1}</span>
        </button>`).join("");
    renderPreviewPage();
}

function renderPreviewPage() {
    const { material, languageCode, page, zoom } = materialPreviewState;
    const viewer = document.getElementById("materialPreviewViewer");
    viewer.style.setProperty("--zoom", zoom);
    viewer.innerHTML = buildPreviewPageHtml(material, page, languageCode);
    viewer.scrollTop = 0;
    document.getElementById("materialPreviewPageInput").value = page;
    document.getElementById("materialPreviewZoomValue").textContent = `${Math.round(zoom * 100)}%`;
    document.getElementById("materialPreviewPrev").disabled = page <= 1;
    document.getElementById("materialPreviewNext").disabled = page >= material.pageCount;
    document.querySelectorAll(".material-preview-thumb").forEach((thumb) => {
        const active = Number(thumb.dataset.previewPage) === page;
        thumb.classList.toggle("is-active", active);
        if (active) thumb.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" });
    });
}

function movePreviewPage(page) {
    const total = materialPreviewState.material.pageCount;
    materialPreviewState.page = Math.min(total, Math.max(1, page));
    renderPreviewPage();
}

function handlePreviewThumbClick(event) {
    const thumb = event.target.closest("[data-preview-page]");
    if (thumb) movePreviewPage(Number(thumb.dataset.previewPage));
}

function handlePreviewPageInputChange(event) {
    movePreviewPage(parseInt(event.target.value, 10) || 1);
}

function changePreviewZoom(delta) {
    materialPreviewState.zoom = Math.min(2, Math.max(0.5, materialPreviewState.zoom + delta));
    renderPreviewPage();
}

/** 언어 전환: 보던 페이지 유지 */
function handlePreviewLanguageClick(event) {
    const button = event.target.closest("[data-language-code]");
    if (!button || button.disabled) return;
    const page = materialPreviewState.page;
    materialPreviewState.languageCode = button.dataset.languageCode;
    renderPreviewAll();
    movePreviewPage(page);
}

function handlePreviewDownloadClick(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const { material, languageCode } = materialPreviewState;
    const file = material.files.find((f) => f.languageCode === languageCode);
    alert(`[목업] ${file.originalFileName} 다운로드\n→ GET /api/download-center/files/${file.fileId}/download`);
}

function handlePreviewKeydown(event) {
    if (!isPreviewOpen()) return;
    if (event.key === "Escape") closeMaterialPreviewModal();
    if (event.target.tagName === "INPUT") return;
    if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") movePreviewPage(materialPreviewState.page - 1);
    if (event.key === "ArrowRight") movePreviewPage(materialPreviewState.page + 1);
}

/** 가상 PDF 페이지 (실제 구현 시 PDF 페이지 렌더링 결과로 대체) */
function buildPreviewPageHtml(material, page, languageCode) {
    const eng = languageCode === "ENG";
    const t = (ko, en) => (eng ? en : ko);
    const total = material.pageCount;
    const cls = `preview-page cover-${material.productGroup}`;
    const no = `<span class="pp-no">${page} / ${total}</span>`;
    const lines = (n) => Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => `<div class="pp-line" style="width:${92 - ((i * 19 + page * 7) % 34)}%"></div>`).join("");

    if (page === 1) {
        return `<div class="${cls}"><div class="pp-cover-blob"></div><span class="pp-brand">myPOSCO DX</span>
            <div class="pp-cover-circle"></div>
            <div class="pp-cover-title"><b>${eng ? material.titleEn : material.title}</b><small>${t("제품 카탈로그", "Product Catalog")} · ${languageCode}</small></div></div>`;
    }
    if (page === total) {
        return `<div class="${cls} is-back"><div class="pp-body"><p class="pp-kicker">${t("문의처", "CONTACT")}</p>
            <p class="pp-title">myPOSCO DX</p><p class="pp-text">${t("제품 문의 · 기술 상담", "Sales & Technical Inquiry")}</p></div>${no}</div>`;
    }
    if (page === 2) {
        const toc = [t("제품 개요", "Overview"), t("주요 특성", "Key Properties"), t("규격 및 치수", "Specifications"), t("주요 용도", "Applications"), t("문의처", "Contact")];
        return `<div class="${cls}"><div class="pp-bar"></div><div class="pp-body"><p class="pp-kicker">${t("목차", "CONTENTS")}</p>
            ${toc.map((s, i) => `<div class="pp-toc"><span>0${i + 1}  ${s}</span><em>${i + 3}</em></div>`).join("")}</div>${no}</div>`;
    }
    const kind = page % 3;
    if (kind === 0) {
        return `<div class="${cls}"><div class="pp-bar"></div><div class="pp-body"><p class="pp-kicker">${t("제품 개요", "OVERVIEW")}</p>
            <p class="pp-title">${eng ? material.titleEn : material.title}</p>
            <p class="pp-text">${eng ? "This is a demo catalog page. Actual catalog content will be rendered from the PDF file." : material.description}</p>
            <div class="pp-image"></div>${lines(4)}</div>${no}</div>`;
    }
    if (kind === 1) {
        return `<div class="${cls}"><div class="pp-bar"></div><div class="pp-body"><p class="pp-kicker">${t("주요 특성", "KEY PROPERTIES")}</p>
            <p class="pp-title">${t("제품 특성", "Product Features")}</p>
            <div class="pp-grid">${[1, 2, 3, 4].map((n) => `<div class="pp-box"><i></i><b>${t("특성", "Feature")} 0${n}</b><div class="pp-line"></div><div class="pp-line" style="width:70%"></div></div>`).join("")}</div>
            ${lines(3)}</div>${no}</div>`;
    }
    const rows = [[t("두께", "Thickness"), "1.2 ~ 25.4 mm"], [t("폭", "Width"), "600 ~ 2,100 mm"], [t("강종", "Grade"), "SS275 / SM355"], [t("표준", "Standard"), "KS · JIS · ASTM"], [t("용도", "Application"), t("건축 · 자동차 · 산업기계", "Construction · Auto · Machinery")]];
    return `<div class="${cls}"><div class="pp-bar"></div><div class="pp-body"><p class="pp-kicker">${t("규격 및 치수", "SPECIFICATIONS")}</p>
        <p class="pp-title">${t("제품 규격", "Product Specifications")}</p>
        <table class="pp-table">${rows.map((r) => `<tr><td>${r[0]}</td><td>${r[1]}</td></tr>`).join("")}</table>
        <div class="pp-image" style="height:8em"></div></div>${no}</div>`;
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
